## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.15.1.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.15.1.pdf** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.15.1.

## What's new

- **Two players against Donovia.** The two-player screen no longer assumes
  Olvana: you join as Red, and the first code sets the campaign and the
  opponent (Olvana or Donovia). The start section names the campaign and the
  opponent it uses, and saved games show the right side's name.
- **Stories name the right opponent.** Some of Blue's shared story lines
  still said "Olvana" in Donovia games, in one and two players. They now name
  the opponent actually being played.
- A new browser test plays a two-player Donovia campaign with two separate
  players and checks that both copies stay identical week by week.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.15 builds.
